A hand-curated checklist

Pokémon on theclock

From lifting beams and building with concrete to digging through the earth, these cards catch Pokémon at work. This starter checklist focuses on clear, hands-on jobs, with more cards to come.

🛠️ Hands-on jobs🗂️ 16 cards · 9 sets🎨 15 illustrators

HOW THIS CHECKLIST IS CURATED

What counts as Pokémon at work?

Cards qualify when Pokémon are clearly doing a practical job or helping with a task—building, lifting, digging, hauling, or clearing snow.
